name: Rclone
description: Web GUI to copy and sync files with over 70 cloud storage services

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Your remotes and their keys (rclone/rclone.conf), the cache and this install's password (.icestore-password). Keep it private.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Your MOS storage, to copy and sync with your cloud remotes. Pick it as a local path, like /data/Documents.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Rclone web GUI, published on host as 6803

ports.name: Port 5572
ports.description: Rclone API that the web GUI talks to, published on host as 6804. It needs the same login.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: RCLONE_GUI_USER
variables.description: The user name for the web GUI. The password is made on first start and shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS.
